content: Error: adapter start failed: Refusing to execute batch script 'C:\\Users\\HardyHeron\\AppData\\Roaming\\npm\\claude.CMD': Windows runs .bat/.cmd files via cmd.exe, which can execute commands injected through CLI arguments, and no reliable escaping for cmd.exe exists. Use a native claude executable instead: install Claude Code natively (irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex), point ClaudeAgentOptions(cli_path=...) at a claude.exe, or install the claude-agent-sdk wheel for a platform that bundles claude.exe (e.g. Windows x64).
